quarterly_data.signal: Cloudflare 10-Q (Q2 2026): restructuring and other charges of $150,693 thousand in the quarter took the GAAP loss from operations to $205,696 thousand (operating margin (30)%); channel partners rose to 31% of revenue from 25% a year earlier; GAAP gross margin 72%; it issued $98,686 thousand of common stock for an acquisition in the first half. It again expects significant component shortages in memory (DIMMs), enterprise SSDs, CPUs and HDDs that may raise the cost of its network equipment and servers.
quarterly_data.figure: restructuring $150,693 thousand; channel partners 31% of revenue
